decision_summary: Retrospective: v0.6.27 converted an impossible readiness requirement into an executable, falsifiable provenance contract.
rationale: Visionary: small provenance primitives unlock later calibration. Builder: a shared shape across current schemas is simple and compatible with existing validators. Guardian: future work must test source semantics and suite health rather than treating verified metadata as truth.
recommendation: Next release should add Evaluation Suite Health records, preserving Evidence Origin as a dependency rather than expanding it into a truth claim.
